versions.changelog:
claw-roundtable-skill v3.0.13

- Enhanced documentation: SKILL.md and README.md rewritten for clarity, now fully bilingual (English/Chinese) with improved structure and more concise descriptions.
- Updated architecture and usage instructions reflecting current system design and capabilities.
- File cleanup: Removed obsolete skill-card.md to streamline project files.
- Improved compliance information and data transparency sections.
- Updated configuration and implementation guides for easier integration and deployment.

**RoundTable v3.0 brings major restructuring and improved modularity.**

- Overhauled project structure: 15 new files added, 24 files removed, and 7 core modules updated for clarity and maintainability.
- New documentation: Added comprehensive guides including README.md, usage examples, and detailed prompts and templates for various scenarios.
- Modularized core features: Separated components for model routing, prompt building, and expert templates for streamlined development.
- Cleanup: Removed legacy integration, installation, and changelog summaries; replaced with clearer, concise, and up-to-date documentation.
- Refined configuration: Improved model and agent selection via dedicated config and template files.
- Updated skill metadata: Reflects new naming and English-language documentation for broader accessibility.

Version 3.0.11

- Major refactor: restructured project layout, moving core modules and logic into a clearer directory structure.
- Added extensive documentation, including installation, integration guides, refactor notes, and detailed changelogs.
- Introduced new modules such as requirement analysis and enhanced agent/model selectors.
- Cleaned up obsolete files, prompts, and templates to streamline the codebase.
- Improved configuration and release scripts for easier deployment and transparency.
v3.0.9: restore clean description — no privacy note in SKILL.md frontmatter

v3.0.8: Fix 12 SkillSpector items — remove global-config.json read (deceptive claim), add fs boundary enforcement in output_dir, privacy warnings in README/SKILL.md/SECURITY.md, accurate notifier declarations, tighten triggers
v3.0.7: Remove examples/ from published files — test data (password123) triggered SkillSpector HARDCODED_CREDENTIAL alerts
v3.0.6: Fix SkillSpector warnings — remove PII (email), drop '深度讨论' trigger, document env vars, secure file paths
v3.0.5: Adjust triggers — 圆桌讨论 & 深度讨论 (more precise)
v3.0.4: Fix ClawHub security audit — add SECURITY.md, tighten triggers, add security/data_privacy fields, sync version
v3.0.3: 重写 SKILL.md，完整设计理念 + 架构 + 容错 + 实测数据
v3.0: 异构模型路由 + MMR意图解析 + 收敛控制，强制批判(5风险+3缺陷)，8周可执行计划

RoundTable Skill V2.0.0 — Major platform overhaul introducing demand-driven expert matching and flexible discussion flow.

- Added requirement analyzer and new roundtable V2 engine for intelligent demand parsing and expert selection.
- Discussions now organized by dynamically identified topics, not fixed rounds; experts assigned per-issue.
- Excludes irrelevant experts and adapts flow to task complexity (low/medium/high).
- Expanded API and documentation, significant refactor with 24 new and 6 updated files.
- Dramatically reduces resource usage for simple/moderate requests; improves relevance and efficiency for all cases.

Version 0.9.3 Changelog

- Expanded skill description to clarify automatic sub-agent creation based on project needs and included detailed behavior about multi-role, multi-model support.
- Added explanation of the benefits for users with multiple models and noted increased token and time consumption.
- Noted the inclusion of 146 expert prompts for specialized sub-agent thinking.
- Clarified that users can contribute opinions during discussions for enhanced results.
- Described suitability for brainstorming and project compliance reviews.

**Major cleanup and simplification in v0.9.2:**
- Removed documentation, prompt, requirements, and template files to streamline the codebase.
- Added `agent_selector.py` to support agent selection functionality.
- The skill’s documentation (`SKILL.md`) now only includes basic descriptions, trigger words, authorship, and run-time behaviors.
- Confirmation is now automatic; manual confirmation is no longer required before starting a discussion.

## v0.9.1

- Added LICENSE file to the project.

RoundTable Skill 0.9.0 – Enhanced via Real-World Testing

- 5-stage discussion process (R1-R5) now fully implemented
- Enforced deep critical review (min. 5 risks, 3 defects analysis)
- Real-time plan evolution with clear change tracking in R4
- Mandatory resolution of disagreements in R5
- Output includes actionable weekly plans and risk contingency
- Improved trigger word recognition
- Real sub-agent invocation and per-round context injection for richer discussions
